design.description: One widened Q17 factory returns a detached register/stack value containing exact raster, diagonal levels and nonzero mask. Luma4 reuses nonzero/last/Flat facts and the existing checked residual-cost core; raster publication follows the existing rate/header bound and selected levels follow the strict winner. Flat means at most three nonzero AC coefficients. Uniform reuse, modes/ties/bounds, packets and cancellation order are unchanged. AVX2/scalar and trellis remain real fallbacks. No buffer, owner, cache or pool.

pairedComparison.scope: Complete frozen 513x259 opaque photographic RGBA8 encode, Q75/effort4; scoped incremental managed-build comparison, not FFmpeg parity or a claim about every VP8 setting.
pairedComparison.boundary: Twelve fixed adjacent original/candidate pairs, alternating order, complete public RGBA8 WebP encodes per subject, fixed operation count recorded per pair, all pairs retained without filtering. Each isolated immutable assembly owns an identical resident source. Setup/JIT/validation excluded; fresh MemoryStream construction/growth, complete encode, independent output and disposal included. Scoped managed-build comparison resolves native-bracket clock uncertainty, not new FFmpeg costs or parity proof.

alpha.interpretation: Adverse standalone raw point retained. Separate captures with material native clock movement do not establish a causal alpha CPU regression or gain; no repeat for favorable numbers.

photograph.boundary: One frozen resident 513x259 opaque RGBA8 photograph or text/diagram to complete owned WebP. Public managed EncodeWebp/admission, source processing, fresh MemoryStream growth/disposal included, no redundant ToArray. Native normalization/repacking, pixel import/encoding and independent packet ownership included. Wrappers/private scratch reused; every pixel reprocessed, no packet cache. Font/image preparation, I/O, IPC, validation and startup excluded. One CPU; effort4, frozen reference quality75. Complete packets exact; VP8L source pixels exact, VP8 identical reconstructed pixels, exact alpha. Quality numbers are not the matching criterion.

alpha.boundary: Resident original RGBA8 to complete independent VP8 WebP bytes with exact normalized alpha. Full source normalization and repacking included. Native codec/scratch/frame/packet wrappers reused; RGBA-to-BGRA repacking and complete encode execute every operation. Fresh managed MemoryStream creation, growth, encode and disposal included; no redundant ToArray. Both effort settings fixed at 4; managed coefficient modeling follows the identified producer's geometry, memory and cancellation eligibility; native adaptive coding declared. Alpha-weighted RGB source-error matching before composite rounding, Complete native packet equality at frozen quality75/method4 is required; matched-packet reconstruction is a sanity check, including hidden RGB. Fresh geometry/decoder/alpha/source/ownership/bitstream checks before/after. Startup, IPC, I/O, fixture generation, quality enumeration and checks excluded.

qualification.existingActualKernelCoverage: Existing exact/native decision and complete-packet corpus plus 26 actual AVX512-off quantization/rate/decision checks each OS. New hardware-specific theories independently check quantization, Flat, prices, signed saturation, all sparse positions, detached values, range/context rejection, canaries and zero allocation/admission change.
qualification.testEpochs: Initial full5639 and focused normal/scalar suites passed. Review found an unparenthesized remainder/switch generator did not select intended families. Corrected grouping, varied all sparse positions and added zero/saturation coverage assertions; rebuilt only the internal test assembly once per OS, then reran the three strengthened cases normal/scalar. Other5636 tests and every production byte were unchanged; reuse their full/live/fallback proof.

storage.preparationStorage: Small fixed value/register-or-stack state fits existing16KiB coarse macroblock allowance; no new substantial heap capacity. Physical stack/peak not measured.
storage.photographAllocationComparison: Standalone current32-operation diagnostic includes3 GCs versus prior16-operation/zero-GC diagnostic. The153B/op difference is not a causal allocation claim. Paired16-operation subjects remain809072B/op each.

uncertainty: Short photograph/alpha screens were leads. One counterbalanced comparison confirms2.32%/286.80us on the frozen photograph. Eight current FFmpeg comparisons remain gaps. Alpha/alpha16 raw adverse points and material native clock movement are retained without causal CPU claims. No further timing confirmation.
corrections: Review corrected precedence in the new test generator and strengthened explicit coverage. Only test modules rebuilt; no production change or completed measurement repeated.
invalidation: Common full-block Q17 publication and residual-cost factoring affect all eight displayed VP8 paths, including distortion-only and trellis; current costs refreshed once. Other affected VP8 H costs and earlier whole-execution/changed-method profiles remain historical. VP8L, PNG/JPEG, decoders, resizing and text/drawing reuse unchanged-path evidence.
